regime.nonidentified_excovid.spec: series with |MCS|>1 after deleting each series' own COVID years (2020-2021); alpha=0.1

regime.nonidentified_full.spec: series with |MCS|>1 on the full sample; absolute loss, alpha=0.1

regime.placebo_below_excovid_median.spec: median across series of the tie-corrected (mid-rank) percentile of the ex-COVID |MCS| within its own 200-draw placebo distribution; 50 means the ex-COVID result is typical of dropping an equal-sized set of non-COVID years -- drawn at random, NOT a contiguous block. |MCS| is a small integer and placebo distributions are often heavily tied, so a strict less-than count would misread a degenerate, perfectly-typical case (100% of draws equal to the ex-COVID value) as maximally extreme rather than as 50

regime.placebo_extreme_series.spec: curated series whose ex-COVID |MCS| sits at or below the 2nd percentile of their own 200-draw placebo distribution -- for these the COVID removal is more extreme than essentially any equal-sized random year-drop, the pattern the aggregate median hides

regime.placebo_nonidentified_pct.spec: share of series whose MEAN placebo |MCS| exceeds 1; placebo drops the same NUMBER of non-COVID years as each series' own COVID years, 200 draws per series, isolating the sample-size effect from the COVID effect

regime.series_mcs_fell_excovid.spec: curated series whose |MCS| strictly DECREASED when their own COVID years were removed. Read beside regime.placebo_extreme_series: the two sets overlap on 3 of 4 (not the full set -- ['BUSINV'] fall without sitting at an extreme placebo percentile).
